items.summary: Top Indian health institutions are partnering with the Armed Forces Medical Services.  These collaborations focus on developing advanced medical solutions for soldiers.  Research areas include trauma care, infectious diseases, and digital health technologies.  This initiative aims to address India's specific climatic and battlefield conditions.  The government is expanding defense-oriented medical research for operational needs.

items.title: BMW India to hike prices again on pressures from rupee depreciation, high commodity costs: CEO
items.summary: BMW Group India will soon increase vehicle prices for the fourth time this year. High commodity costs and rupee depreciation are pressuring the company's profit margins. The German luxury car maker has already implemented three price revisions in 2026. New BMW 7 Series models, including the electric i7, are now available. Deliveries for these new models will commence from October 2026.

items.title: Ultraviolette sees Indian motorcycle market going 20% electric in 2-3 years
items.summary: Ultraviolette Automotive anticipates electric motorcycles will capture twenty percent of India's market soon. The company is investing heavily in a new manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu. This expansion will significantly increase production capacity for their electric vehicles. Ultraviolette plans to launch several new models, including more affordable options. The firm also aims to expand its presence into North and Latin American markets.

items.title: India says 'I do' as wedding boom sends hotel bookings soaring
items.summary: Hotels are experiencing a significant increase in wedding bookings for upcoming seasons.  Most prime dates at popular destinations are already reserved by planners.  Enquiries and confirmed bookings are arriving four to six months in advance.  Hoteliers anticipate double-digit revenue growth in the wedding segment.  Spending on curated guest experiences and personalized decor is also rising.

items.title: Marengo Asia Hospitals raises Rs 400 crore from LeapFrog Investments to double bed capacity
items.summary: Marengo Asia Hospitals has raised Rs 400 crore from LeapFrog Investments to expand its hospital network, with plans to more than double capacity to over 4,000 beds within two years. Backed by Samara Capital and Godrej and Havells family offices, Marengo operates five hospitals across the NCR, Gujarat and Rajasthan.

items.title: As assured, Russia to further boost fertiliser supplies to India: Andrey Guryev at BRICS
items.summary: Russia has significantly increased fertilizer shipments to India this year.  President Putin assured Prime Minister Modi of continued vital agricultural supplies.  Russian producers supplied 6.5 million tonnes of fertilizers to India last year.  India now imports one in every three tonnes of fertilizer from Russia.  BRICS nations receive half of all Russian mineral fertilizer exports.

items.title: Imported dialysis solution fails endotoxin test in Himachal; lab flags nine regulatory violations
items.summary: A Himachal Pradesh government drug laboratory has declared two batches of an imported peritoneal dialysis solution “Not of Standard Quality” after they failed bacterial endotoxin tests. The report also flagged nine regulatory violations, including use of non-Indian pharmacopoeial standards, labelling deficiencies, missing safety warnings and inadequate importer details.

items.title: Non-grocery sections emerging as big business in quick commerce: Flipkart exec
items.summary: Quick commerce platforms are expanding beyond groceries to include electronics and beauty products. Flipkart Minutes is focusing on non-grocery categories for the upcoming festive season. Industry estimates show non-grocery items now form a significant portion of quick commerce business. Flipkart Minutes plans to add more fulfillment centers to support this expansion. The company is improving its profit margins and aims for profitability through scale.

items.title: Stellantis Signs Memo with Roshel for Possible Sale of Idle Plant
items.summary: Stellantis NV has signed a memorandum with a Canadian armored vehicle manufacturer that outlines steps toward the sale of an idled car factory near Toronto — a move that represents yet another ripple effect of US tariffs on the Canadian auto sector.

items.summary: GAIL Gas employs blended pricing to keep industrial natural gas affordable.  This strategy uses varied gas supplies and contractual flexibility to sustain demand.  Global fuel prices have surged, impacting industrial and commercial customers significantly.  Sales to industrial clients are currently ten percent below last year's levels.  GAIL Gas's procurement portfolio aids in offering lower blended prices.

items.title: As China slows, global FMCG and consumer giants from L'Oreal to Nestle bet big on India
items.summary: India is becoming a key growth focus for global consumer companies. Rising incomes and expanding retail offer significant untapped market potential. Companies see opportunities to increase consumption and introduce new products. This shift occurs as China's growth moderates and mature markets show less room. India's large population presents a substantial long-term opportunity for expansion.

items.title: Russia’s Sberbank plans major India push, to build business hub
items.summary: Sberbank CEO Herman Gref announced plans for new financial and technology infrastructure tools. The bank will establish the largest Russian business hub in India, expanding its presence. Sberbank has been developing its financial business in India for sixteen years. Money transfers between India and Russia now take only minutes, improving business opportunities. Two office buildings are under construction and will be commissioned in 2028.

items.title: IEA slashes oil demand forecast as prices surge
items.summary: The International Energy Agency on Friday further reduced its forecast for global oil demand this year, citing the recent escalation in the Mideast war and resurgent energy prices. Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and other energy targets are also taking a toll, driving up global fuel prices that will lead consumers to reduce their purchases, the agency said.

items.title: BRICS finance chiefs flag tariff risks, push cross-border payments
items.summary: BRICS finance ministers voiced concerns over unilateral trade actions and tariffs. They endorsed efforts for cross-border payment interoperability and local currency settlements. The group also called for reforms of global financial institutions like the IMF. These reforms aim to give emerging markets greater voice and representation. The leaders met in Mumbai to discuss these pressing global economic issues.

items.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited and Drydocks World will jointly operate the International Ship Repair Facility. This partnership aims to expand the facility to meet growing regional and global demand. The collaboration will create additional capacity for servicing a wider range of vessels. items.title: India-EU FTA progress: European Commission moves to get it signed
items.summary: The European Commission has formally proposed signing a Free Trade Agreement with India. This proposal clears the path for early approval by the European Council. Over ninety-nine percent of Indian exports will gain duty-free entry into the EU bloc. The European Union will receive access to the Indian market for cars and wines. Both sides anticipate the Free Trade Agreement will come into force in early 2027.

items.title: BlackRock private credit fund sees redemption pressure ease in third quarter
items.summary: BlackRock's flagship private credit fund saw lower redemption requests in the third quarter, signalling that pressure in the sector may be easing. Withdrawal requests at other BlackRock funds also declined, while analysts said improving sentiment and a clearing redemption backlog could support private credit firms and asset managers.

items.title: FM Sitharaman pushes RBI to sharpen digital rupee as tokenisation takes off
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged the Reserve Bank of India to advance digital rupee pilots. She highlighted tokenisation's role in enabling near-instantaneous settlement of financial transactions. Sitharaman advocated for a soft-touch regulatory approach to emerging technologies like artificial intelligence. She warned of AI's risks while emphasizing responsible adoption for competitiveness. Greater coordination among regulators and industry self-regulation were also called for.

The EU aims to finalize its trade deal with India in December.

items.summary: An SBI research report recommends the Reserve Bank of India raise interest rates.  The central bank should implement a 25 basis point hike next month, it says. The report advocates for a second rate increase in December.

items.title: Bank of India mobilises $2.33 billion via FCNR(B), enough to meet one-quarter lending needs: CEO
items.summary: Bank of India secured USD 2.33 billion through FCNR(B) deposits, replacing bulk funding sources.
